name: Single Page Application (SPA)
description: An ``SPA`` is a web application or website that interacts with the user by dynamically rewriting the current page, rather than loading entire new pages from the server. This approach provides a smoother and more fluid user experience, as the page doesn't need to be fully reloaded for every interaction. ``SPA`` often use JavaScript frameworks like ``htmx``, ``React``, ``Angular``, or ``Vue.js`` to handle these dynamic updates and manage the application state.
